name: Ticket → PR
summary: Take a ticket from plan to a reviewed-ready draft PR.
when: The work is understood and needs building, verifying and shipping.
fanOutHint: One independent piece per line — each gets its own worktree (e.g. "renderer: debounce the draft").

stages.name: Plan
stages.instruction: Read the ticket and the relevant code. Produce a short plan: the files you will touch and how you will verify the change. Do not write code yet.

stages.name: Branch
stages.instruction: Create the working branch for this initiative, following the repository's branch naming. Never work on master.

stages.name: Implement
stages.instruction: Implement the change. Keep it to the stated goal — no unrelated refactors.

stages.name: Verify
stages.instruction: Run the verification command for this project and make it pass. Fix what it reports rather than working around it.

stages.name: Commit
stages.instruction: Commit the work in focused commits following the repository conventions.

stages.name: Push & draft PR
stages.instruction: Push the branch and open a draft pull request describing what changed and how it was verified.
